column1: # The unsafe foreign calls of the Haskell sources under modules (root ADR 0435):
# the path of the module, the name of the C function, the number of the reason
# and the reason, split by tabs. The reasons are 1, a call that is short
# whatever its input and waits for no lock; 2, a call made so often that a safe
# call costs too much, kept unsafe with the reason; 3, a call that is meant to
# hold its capability. scripts/ci/test.sh checks that the sources have exactly
# these; every other foreign import is safe.
